# Handover and incident pack

## Operator handover

| Area | Owner | Procedure / evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| User onboarding | | One routine task and teach-back |
| Identity and credentials | | Ownership and rotation procedure; no secret values |
| Data refresh | | Source, frequency, freshness check |
| Deployment | | Version, environment, health and task checks |
| Backup and restore | | Last tested restore, recovery time, observed data loss |
| Monitoring | | User-task success, failures, latency, queue delay, cost |
| Escalation | | Contact role, severity, and response expectations |
